text:
Dana (CS): Quick renewal flag for Borealis Labs. They want to move from 12mo to 24mo at a 12% discount, with annual true-up and split invoicing: EU ops pays 60% and US parent pays 40%. Signer will be Borealis EU Ltd. Can we accept split remit + multi-year without an amendment? @Rahul please confirm asks.
Rahul (AE): Customer note: '24mo at -12% if we accept split invoicing to two legal entities. Borealis EU Ltd will sign; Borealis Inc (US) will handle 40% remit. We can provide PO for EU side and W-9 for US side.'
Priya (Legal): Two quick concerns: 1) Multi-year discount and true-up need to be captured in SOW or amendment. 2) If signer is EU entity but part of payment is from US parent, we need a POA or intercompany agreement showing payment responsibility. Also check whether EU PO contains conflicting terms.
Tom (Finance): We can support split invoicing across two remit-to entities, but AR needs separate vendor records and tax docs (EU invoice details, US W-9/EIN). We'll require the PO numbers and invoice distribution percentages in writing. Also need to confirm preferred payment method (wire preferred).
Jules (Onboarding): Onboarding: We can schedule kickoff once first invoice clears or we receive confirmed PO + remit info for EU side. For SSO provisioning we need a single owner email; if two entities pay, pick a primary admin.
contracts-bot: Created amendment_request #AMND-7210 for multi-year discount and entity split. Assigned to @Priya and @Tom. ETA 4 business days.
Dana (CS): Proposed steps: 1) Rahul to request EU PO + US W-9 + written split percentages and PO numbers, 2) Priya to review PO and draft amendment capturing 24mo term + true-up, 3) Tom to create vendor records once docs verified, 4) Jules to reserve onboarding slots pending payment/PO. Any objections? :white_check_mark:
Rahul (AE): I'll ping the customer now. Draft message: 'Can you attach EU PO, US remit W-9/EIN, and confirm invoice split (60% EU / 40% US) plus PO numbers? Also confirm signatory and whether you can provide POA linking EU signatory to US payment obligation.'
Priya (Legal): If POA is supplied, ask for explicit commercial signing rights and a date range covering the 24mo term. If the EU PO has procurement terms, flag conflicts early.
Tom (Finance): Note for AR: once vendor mapping is complete, we will send two invoices referencing the same master contract and linking to AMND-7210 via cross-ref. Until then do not provision full production access.
Dana (CS): Customer responded: 'Uploading EU PO and US W-9 now, POA possible but will take 48hrs. We prefer to wire the first annual payment and do quarterly wires thereafter.' I'll update when files arrive. Tracking: AMND-7210 open, docs pending.
